label: RB751U-2HnD
description: MikroTik RB751U-2HnD (RB751U-2HnD) — 5x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR7241.
notes: Inlet is eth1, and this board sources nothing. https://mikrotik.com/product/RB751U-2HnD (read 2026-11-28): "Number of DC inputs 1", "PoE in Passive PoE", no max-power-consumption row and no PoE-out row. https://cdn.mikrotik.com/web-assets/product_files/rb751U-2HnD-ug_130539.pdf (RouterBOARD 751 series User’s Manual): "Power over Ethernet Ether 1 requires 8-30V DC (non 802.3af)", "Power consumption Up to 7W", and "Under maximum load, the power consumption of this device is 7W"; the manual lists Ether1-5 as plain RJ45 ports and gives no PoE output. eth1 draws 7 W; eth2-eth5 are poeIn: false.
